title: AI pages claim Ben Needham (and other missing kids) “found” (The Star)
why: [news (surreal specimen)] Claim: Official Help Find Ben Needham page warns of AI-generated “reunited” photos. Facebook “UK Hot News” / Midnight Wire branding runs a farm of solved-case fantasies — Ben Needham “DNA confirmation,” Madeleine McCann as a homeless woman in America, Andrew Gosden reunited — built from police age-progressions.
